verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a scriptable document-conversion CLI and library. A tool of this kind could plausibly ship watch or scheduled-run features, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no first-party autonomous or background automation capability. Running it through GitHub Actions is a host-platform capability, scripting it into pipelines is a user-side workaround, and pandoc-server is an on-demand HTTP conversion mode rather than background automation; none of these earn credit.
